label: Battery Icon
author: Conky-Studio
description: Classic battery silhouette with fill level from Value (0-100). Optional charging mark when Charging is truthy.
lua_draw_body:
local x, y, w, h = {x}, {y}, {width}, {height}
 local pct = math.min(math.max((tonumber({value}) or 0) / 100, 0), 1)
 local tip = math.max(3, w * 0.08)
 local body_w = w - tip
 local tr, tg, tb = {track_color}
 local fr, fg, fb = {color}
 local lr, lg, lb = {low_color}
 if (tonumber({value}) or 0) <= {low_threshold} then fr, fg, fb = lr, lg, lb end
 cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, tr, tg, tb, {opacity})
 local rad = math.min(h * 0.2, 4)
 cairo_new_sub_path(cr)
 cairo_arc(cr, x + body_w - rad, y + rad, rad, -math.pi/2, 0)
 cairo_arc(cr, x + body_w - rad, y + h - rad, rad, 0, math.pi/2)
 cairo_arc(cr, x + rad, y + h - rad, rad, math.pi/2, math.pi)
 cairo_arc(cr, x + rad, y + rad, rad, math.pi, 3*math.pi/2)
 cairo_close_path(cr)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 cairo_rectangle(cr, x + body_w, y + h * 0.28, tip, h * 0.44)
 cairo_fill(cr)
 local pad = 2.5
 local fw = (body_w - pad * 2) * pct
 if fw > 0 then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, fr, fg, fb, {opacity})
  cairo_rectangle(cr, x + pad, y + pad, fw, h - pad * 2)
  cairo_fill(cr)
 end
 if (tonumber({charging}) or 0) >= 0.5 then
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, 1, 1, 1, {opacity} * 0.9)
  local cx, cy = x + body_w * 0.5, y + h * 0.5
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2)
  cairo_move_to(cr, cx + 2, cy - h * 0.28)
  cairo_line_to(cr, cx - 3, cy + 1)
  cairo_line_to(cr, cx + 1, cy + 1)
  cairo_line_to(cr, cx - 2, cy + h * 0.28)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
